recentItems.title: Keeper at wildlife park killed by salt water crocodile in PNG | ABC NEWS
recentItems.description:
A worker at a Port Moresby wildlife park has died a day after being attacked by a crocodile at feeding time.
Onlookers say the man's legs were in the crocodile's mouth for about an hour before emergency services arrived.

recentItems.title: Fears of a looming crisis in Nepal as two more found alive | ABC NEWS
recentItems.description:
Against all odds, two more people have been rescued in Nepal, ten days since the flooding disaster that devastated the border region with Tibet, wiping away entire towns.
Nearly five thousand people remain missing, including 36 Australians, and groups are warning conditions are becoming increasingly dire for the survivors.

recentItems.title: Passenger recounts diverted Qantas flight | ABC NEWS
recentItems.description:
A passenger has described the moment flames appeared to shoot from one side of a Sydney-bound Qantas flight soon after take-off.
 
Qantas says the plane experienced a suspected engine issue after leaving Queenstown on Saturday. The flight was diverted to Christchurch and the plane is temporarily grounded.
 
Qantas flew engineers over to New Zealand to inspect the aircraft as part of an investigation into what caused the issue.
 
Gavin Coote via ABC News NSW
